summary: Frequency Electronics Inc. filed an 8-K to report entering into a $10 million senior secured revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase Bank. The facility has a three-year term maturing June 12, 2029, with an accordion feature allowing an increase of up to an additional $10 million. Borrowings bear interest at Prime plus 2.50% or SOFR plus 2.50%. The obligation is guaranteed by subsidiary FEI-Zyfer and secured by substantially all assets. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes and working capital. This is a routine financing arrangement—not a special situation—and thus classified as None.
